import sys
from collections import deque

INF = 10**15

def solve():
    data = list(map(int, sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()))
    it = iter(data)
    n = next(it); m = next(it); k = next(it); c = next(it); d = next(it)
    ii = [next(it)-1 for _ in range(k)]
    adj = [[] for _ in range(n)]
    for _ in range(m):
        i = next(it)-1; j = next(it)-1
        adj[i].append(j)
        adj[j].append(i)
    t = n + k + 1
    N = n * t + 1
    aa = [[] for _ in range(N)]
    uu = []; vv = []; uv = []; cost = []; cc = []
    def link(u, v, cap, cos):
        h = len(uu)
        uu.append(u); vv.append(v); uv.append(u ^ v); cost.append(cos)
        cc.append(cap)
        cc.append(0)
        aa[u].append(2*h)
        aa[v].append(2*h+1)
    for i in range(n):
        for s in range(t-1):
            u = i*t + s
            for j in adj[i]:
                v = j*t + s+1
                for x in range(1, k+1):
                    link(u, v, 1, c + (2*x-1)*d)
    for i in range(n):
        for s in range(t-1):
            u = i*t + s
            v = u + 1
            cap = k
            cos = 0 if i == 0 else c
            link(u, v, cap, cos)
    for h in range(k):
        link(N-1, ii[h]*t + 0, 1, 0)
    S = N-1
    T = t-1
    pi = [INF]*N
    dd = [0]*N
    bb = [-1]*N
    iq = [False]*N
    def spfa(s, t):
        for i in range(N):
            pi[i] = INF
            dd[i] = 0
            bb[i] = -1
            iq[i] = False
        pi[s] = 0
        q = deque()
        q.append(s)
        iq[s] = True
        while q:
            u = q.popleft()
            iq[u] = False
            d = dd[u] + 1
            for h_ in aa[u]:
                if cc[h_] > 0:
                    h = h_ >> 1
                    p = pi[u] + (cost[h] if (h_ & 1) == 0 else -cost[h])
                    v = u ^ uv[h]
                    if pi[v] > p or (pi[v] == p and dd[v] > d):
                        pi[v] = p
                        dd[v] = d
                        bb[v] = h_
                        if not iq[v]:
                            iq[v] = True
                            q.append(v)
        return pi[t] != INF
    def push1(s, t):
        u = t
        while u != s:
            h_ = bb[u]
            h = h_ >> 1
            cc[h_] -= 1
            cc[h_ ^ 1] += 1
            u = u ^ uv[h]
    while spfa(S, T):
        push1(S, T)
    total = 0
    for h in range(len(uu)):
        total += cost[h] * cc[2*h+1]
    print(total)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()
